contracts.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by July 31?
Will the 7-day moving average of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch be above 60 before August 1, 2026?

rolloverWarning.note: Two large contracts feeding this forecast resolve within a day of each other: polymarket "Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by July 31?" ($21.67M of $106.11M pooled polymarket volume) resolves 2026-07-31; kalshi "Will the 7-day moving average of transit calls through the Strait of Hormuz as reported by the IMF PortWatch be above 60 before August 1, 2026?" ($5.22M of $10.93M pooled kalshi volume) resolves 2026-08-01. fetchMarkets.ts drops each contract from the composite the tick after it resolves, so the published value is expected to step down by roughly 10 points around these dates with nothing changing in the world. Read that step as a contract rollover, not a new signal.
